fields.v: Differential attrition in lowest stratum; H6 lexical detector failed (recall 0.49); canonical-name detectors give lower bounds; H2 may be invisible (external memory services); early-adopter bias; H5 detector English-only; no outcome variables, no efficacy claims. Future: effect of the harness with pre-registered outcome study; team size measure; cumulative incidence analysis; practitioner study for H2
